_readme: Country-specific building energy factors used by services/buildingEnergy.js. Fill in 'value', 'source' and 'year' from a published source (national GHG inventory, IFI dataset, utility declaration). While 'value' is null the global default is used and the Building Energy page shows a warning. Keys: toKwh '<fuel>:<unit>' (kWh per unit), emission '<fuel>' (kgCO2e per kWh).

natural_gas:m3.note: Armenian natural-gas net calorific value, kWh per m³ (to be confirmed by Foundation to Save Energy)

electricity.note: Armenia average grid emission factor, kgCO2e per kWh (Scope 2 location-based). Note: the CDM standardized-baseline combined margin (0.39 tCO2/MWh) is a project-baseline factor, not a grid average.

natural_gas.note: Gas combustion factor, kgCO2e per kWh — IPCC default is used until set

AMD.note: AMD per 1 USD (e.g. Central Bank of Armenia rate) — USD savings are hidden while null
